move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You keep the quote brief and head straight back to the machines—it sounds like you value a discussion that gets to the point. We want competitive pricing with delivery expectations that work in practice. What flexibility on price would a more accommodating delivery schedule give you?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0). Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:SH-220). Our demand forecast for this part is on record (fc:SH-220@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Hallo, the 42 days lead time gives us breathing room on the machines, and I hear you on the volume. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

Our current Angebot is a price of €15.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP. I can beat your other offer and go down to 15.40 for the DAP delivery. In return, I need 14 days payment to keep things moving on our end. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium. We have free capacity for your parts. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.

Alternatively, a price of €15.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH
